plugins.globalOffBanner: Plugins are turned off globally, so none of them run.
plugins.hostTableCaption: Network hosts the plugin declares and the ones you allowed
plugins.hostHelp: "Declared" hosts are the ones the plugin says it will contact; "Allowed" ones are the hosts you approved. After you revoke one, the plugin asks again the next time it connects.
plugins.reasonGlobalOff: Plugins are turned off globally, so commands cannot run.
plugins.reasonPluginOff: This plugin is turned off. Turn it on to run its commands.
plugins.targetPetLabel: Which pet shows notifications and reactions
plugins.targetPetHelp: Only affects this plugin's notification bubbles and pet reactions. Defaults to the primary pet.
plugins.installSucceededGlobalOff: Installed {name}. Plugins are off globally, so it will not run until you turn them on.
plugins.enableAll: Turn on plugins and this one
plugins.permNetworkUserGranted: Ask to connect to other domains when needed (you are asked each time)
plugins.hintNetwork: The plugin can send data to and receive data from this domain.
plugins.hintNetworkUserGranted: The plugin can ask to connect to other domains and you are asked each time.
plugins.hintLinks: The plugin panel can ask your browser to open links on this domain, but cannot connect by itself.
plugins.hintSecrets: The plugin can read this secret that you enter in its settings.
plugins.hintStorage: The plugin can keep its own data on this device, within a size limit.
plugins.hintSchedule: The plugin can run work in the background on a schedule.
plugins.hintAgentStatus: The plugin can see whether an agent is busy, idle or waiting.
plugins.hintFeed: The plugin can show notifications next to your pet.
plugins.hintReaction: The plugin can ask your pet to react.
plugins.hintPanel: The plugin can show its own panel inside Agent Pets.
plugins.hintCommands: Command buttons provided by the plugin appear in its panel.
plugins.hintTray: The plugin can add items to the tray menu.
plugins.hintBadge: The plugin can show a small badge next to your pet.
plugins.hintSkins: The plugin adds extra pet skins you can choose.
plugins.hintEventSource: The plugin can report its own work status in a separate status row.
plugins.hintUnknown: This permission is not recognised. Review it carefully.
plugins.sheetIncompatibleBody: Ask the author for a compatible version.
plugins.ackHeading: High-risk changes that need your confirmation
plugins.ackReasonKeyChanged: The author's signing key differs from the one you trusted before. Make sure you trust the new key.
plugins.ackReasonRemoved: This version drops the earlier signature, so it cannot be verified as coming from the same author.
plugins.ackReasonNetwork: This update adds network or external link permissions.
plugins.ackReasonSecrets: This update adds permission to read secrets.
plugins.emptyTitle: Plugins add reminders, panels and looks to your pet
plugins.emptyDescription: Pick one from the online catalog or install a local plugin file you trust. You always see the permissions a plugin asks for before it is installed.
plugins.emptyDescriptionOff: Plugins are turned off. Turn them on, then pick one from the catalog or install a local file. Installed plugins start disabled and you turn each one on yourself.
plugins.catalogOffDescription: When on, Agent Pets contacts the configured catalog index to list plugins and updates. It only reads the list and never downloads or installs anything by itself.
plugins.catalogEmpty: The catalog has no plugins right now.
plugins.inboxEmptyHelp: Plugins can send notifications here. To hear less from one, mute it on its details page.
plugins.panelStillLoading: {name} is still loading. You can keep waiting or cancel.
plugins.panelFailedTitle: The {name} panel could not be shown
plugins.removeHelp: Removing deletes the plugin's files. By default its settings and data are kept so a reinstall picks up where you left off.
plugins.removeDeleteData: Also delete its settings and data
plugins.removeDeleteDataHelp: This includes saved settings, secrets and permissions. This cannot be undone.
plugins.hostRevoked: Revoked access to {host}. The plugin will ask again the next time it connects.
plugins.settingErrorRange: The value is outside the allowed range.
plugins.settingErrorNotAllowed: Choose one of the listed options.
plugins.secretReplacePlaceholder: Enter a new value to replace the current secret
plugins.secretRemoveHelp: The plugin will no longer be able to read it and you will need to enter it again.
plugins.secretStorageNote: Encrypted in the system keychain and kept on this computer only. It is never uploaded.
plugins.discardHelp: Settings you changed but did not save will be lost.
plugins.reportPreview: This opens the plugin catalog's GitHub issue page in your browser with only a title filled in: the plugin ID, its version and whether it was installed locally. No logs, settings or personal data are attached, and you can add details yourself before submitting.
plugins.developerWarning: Developer mode is on: you can load unsigned local folders whose contents are not verified. Turn it off if you are not developing plugins.
plugins.errDialogUnavailable: Could not open the file picker. Try again.
plugins.errInstallFailed: The install failed. Check that the file is complete, or try a different file.
plugins.errRegistryUnavailable: The installed plugin list is temporarily unavailable. Try again later or restart Agent Pets.
plugins.errInvalidRequest: That request was not valid. Refresh and try again.
plugins.reasonNotPermitted: the plugin does not have this permission
plugins.reasonOther: it did not meet the rules
plugins.presenceHeading: Where it shows up in the app
plugins.presenceTray: {count} command items in the tray menu
plugins.presenceTrayOverflow: the tray item limit of 30 was exceeded, so some commands are hidden
plugins.presenceBadge: The badge next to your pet currently reads "{text}"
plugins.presenceBadgeNone: Badge next to your pet: nothing to show right now
plugins.presenceSkins: Provides {count} pet skins you can pick in the Pets settings
plugins.presenceEventSourceNone: Work status row: nothing reported right now
plugins.dashTabFeedEmpty: This plugin has no recent notifications.
